serverName.description: Name of the statically declared MCP server this adapter binds.

mcpUrl.description: Loopback MCP endpoint of the SFOA runtime.

mcpWecomClientToken.description: SecretInput for the SFOA WeCom channel credential. Prefer a SecretRef.

attachmentBridgeEnabled.description: Stage the files a WeCom message carried into the SFOA Attachment Ingress and inject their att_… references into the turn. Off by default; the runtime side needs MCP_ATTACHMENT_INGRESS_ENABLED=true as well.

attachmentIngressPath.description: Ingress path resolved against mcpUrl's origin. Defaults to /attachments.

attachmentWorkspaceRoot.description: Absolute OpenClaw workspace root a media path may be resolved against. Defaults to /data/openclaw/workspace.

attachmentMediaRoot.description: Absolute staging root an inbound file must sit below to be forwarded. Prefer attachmentMediaRoots; this single-root spelling replaces the defaults with exactly this one root.

attachmentMediaRoots.description: Absolute staging roots an inbound file may sit below. Setting this replaces the defaults entirely, so naming your own roots cannot be widened by a default. Defaults to [/data/openclaw/workspace/media/inbound, /data/openclaw/state/media/inbound]: the workspace copy OpenClaw's sandbox stages, and the copy the WeCom channel plugin downloads itself and reports in the hook context.

attachmentRefTtlMs.description: How long a staged reference stays available to the model. Defaults to 300000.
